verses.text: Ha winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Jerobaal, ix b'at winh t'a Siquem lolonel yet' heb' sk'ab' yok ix snun, ix yalan winh t'a heb':

--Ha tikne'ik swal t'ayex to wach' tze montej heb' eyetchonhab' t'a Siquem tik, tze k'anb'an t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Wach'am tzeyab'i to a 70 heb' yuninal winhaj Jerobaal syak' yajalil t'a kib'anh, mato wach' to junnhej winh tz'och kajalilok? xe chi t'a heb'. Naekkoti to a innhej ay wuj in b'a heyet'ok, xchi winh.

Ha heb' ayto yuj sb'a chi' yet' winh, ix syamoch heb' yalan t'a heb' yetchonhab' t'a Siquem chi' to a winhaj Abimelec chi' tz'och yajalil t'a skal heb'. Ix scha sk'ol heb' chonhab' chi' icha chi', yujto ayto yuj sb'a heb' yet' winh.

Yuj chi' ix yik'elta 70 siclo k'e'en plata heb' t'a yol stemplo komon Dios skuchan Baal-berit, ix yak'an k'e'en heb' t'a winhaj Abimelec chi'. Ha yet' k'e'en ix stup juntzanh heb' winh jaragana winak winh yik tz'och heb' winh yet' winh. Te chuk juntzanh heb' winh winak chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh yet' winh t'a Ofra, b'aj ek'nak winh smam winh. Hata' ix smilcham 70 heb' yuk'tak winh t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en k'e'en. Haxonhej winhaj Jotam ix kolchajkani, yujto ix sk'ub'ejkanel sb'a winh, haton winh slajwub' yuninal winhaj Jerobaal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' aj Siquem yet' heb' aj Bet-milo t'a yich jun te' mach' t'a Siquem chi', b'aj ay jun k'e'en k'e'en niwan yelk'och t'a heb'. Hata' ix yak'och winhaj Abimelec heb' yajalil.

Ayik ix alchaj jun chi' t'a winhaj Jotam chi', ix k'e winh t'a jun tzalan t'a spak'ul lum witzal Gerizim, te cha'anh ix awajemta winh yik wach' masanil mach tz'ab'ani, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ex aj Siquem, maklejek eyab' jun ab'ix ol wal tik yik wach' ol yab' Dios tas ol eyala'.
Ha junel, masanil ab' te te' ix snib'ej yak'och junok yajalil. Yuj chi' ix ab' yal te' t'a te' olivo to tz'och te' yajalilok te' smasanil.
Ix ab' tak'wi te' olivo chi', ix yalan te': Ma'ay, tato tzin och eyajalilok he masanil, maxtzak am wak'laj aceite sk'anchaj yuj yik'jicha'anh Dios, ma yik sk'anpax heb' anima, xchab' te'.
Ixlajwi chi', ab' yalanpax te' smasanil t'a te' higo yik tz'och te' yajalil.
Ix ab' yalanpax te' higo chi': Ma'ay, tato tzin och eyajalilok he masanil, maxtzak am wak' in sat te chi' sloji, xchab' te'.
Ix ab' yalanpax te' t'a te' uwa to tz'och te' yajalil.
Ix ab' yalanpax te' uwa chi': Ma'ay, tato tzin och eyajalilok he masanil, tzam waktej wak'an wino tz'ak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol Dios yet' heb' anima, xchab' te'.
Slajwub'alxo ix ab' yalan te' t'a te' k'i'ix to tz'och te' yajalil.

Ix ab' yalan te' k'i'ix chi' to syal yoch te' yajalilok te te' chi' smasanil. Ix ab' yalan te': Tato yel t'a smasanil he k'ol tzin eyak'och eyajalilok, ochanhek t'a yalanh wenhul tik he masanil. Tato max yal he k'ol tzin och eyajalilok jun, elokab'kot jun niwan k'ak' t'ayin yik stz'akanb'at te' k'ute' t'a Líbano, xchab' te' k'i'ix chi'.
Ha tikne'ik jun, tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex: ¿Tom yel wal wach' ix he k'ulej, yuj chi' ix eyak'och winhaj Abimelec chi' eyajalilok? ¿Tom smoj wal icha chi' tzeyutej yinhtilal winhaj Jerobaal chi' tikne'ik?
Ix sb'ek sb'a winh in mam chi' scham eyu'uj ayik ex skolanelta winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' madianita.

Ha exxo tik, tas xom wal eyaji, yuj chi' tzex meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a yinhtilal winh in mam chi'. Ix he milcham 70 yuninal winh t'a jun k'e'en k'e'en, haxo winhaj Abimelec yune' jun ix schekab' winh in mam chi' ix eyak'och eyajalilok, anhej am yujto ayto eyuj he b'a yet' winh yuj snun.
Swalan t'ayex tikne'ik: Tato wach' tze k'ulej t'a xilb'a in mam yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal, tzalajk'olalokab' heyaj yet' winhaj Abimelec chi', wach'nhejokab' ol aj yelk'och winh t'a he kal.

Tato manh wach'ok jun, elokab'kot junok niwan k'ak' t'a winhaj Abimelec chi', yik tzex tz'ab'at ex aj Siquem yet' ex aj Bet-milo. Haxo t'ayex tz'elpaxkot junok k'ak', yik stz'apaxb'at winhaj Abimelec chi', xchi winhaj Jotam chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Jotam chi', el lemnaj winh, ix b'at kajnajkan winh t'a Beer, yujto xiw winh t'a winhaj Abimelec winh yuk'tak chi'.
Oxe' ab'il ix yak' yajalil winhaj Abimelec t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi'.
Haxo Dios ix ak'anoch jun ajk'olal t'a skal winh yet' heb' aj Siquem chi', ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'a winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji spak t'a winh yuj schamel 70 heb' winh yuk'tak smilnakchamok. Ix ak'jipax spak t'a heb' aj Siquem chi', yujto ix yak'och sb'a heb' yet' winhaj Abimelec chi' t'a schukal chi'.

Ha heb' aj Siquem chi', ay heb' sb'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a titak b'e t'a spak'ultak lum witz, tz'elta heb' t'a heb' anima tzek' t'a yol b'e tzek' t'a slak'anil chonhab' chi' yik tz'elk'an heb'. Ix alji yab' winhaj Abimelec to icha chi' sk'ulej heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix k'och jun winh skuchan Gaal yuninal winhaj Ebed yet' heb' sk'ab' yok t'a Siquem chi', wach' ix kan winh t'a yol sat heb' anima ta'.

Ayik k'inhxo te' uwa, tz'el heb' t'a spatikel chonhab', yik smolan te' heb', sb'o'an wino heb'. Ix yak'anoch jun k'inh heb', ix och ijan heb' swa'i yet' yuk'wi anh heb' t'a yol stemplo sdiosal. Ha wal ta' te chuk ix yal heb' t'a spatik winhaj Abimelec chi'.

Ix och ijan winhaj Gaal chi' yalani: ¿Mach jun winhaj Abimelec chi' yalani, yuj chi' tzonh yak' mandar winh? Ha winh chi', yuninal winh winhaj Jerobaal, haxo pax winhaj Zebul schekab' winh. Ha heb' winh chi' malaj yelk'och heb' winh. Ha onh pax aj Siquem onh tik, ¿tas yuj tonhej skak' ko b'a t'a winh? ¿Tom ol onh ochnhej schekab'ok heb' winh? Ko naekkot tikne'ik to a winh ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Hamor, winh b'oannakk'e chonhab' Siquem tik, yuj chi' kik'ekel ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Abimelec chi'.
A... tato a in eyajalil in, toxom ix in satel winhaj Abimelec chi', tzam wal t'a winh: Molb'ej heb' a soldado skak'an owal, xin chama, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Zebul, yajal t'a Siquem chi' tas ix yal winhaj Gaal chi', ix te kot yowal winh.
Elanhchamel ix yalb'at winh t'a winhaj Abimelec t'a elk'altak icha tik: Ix jawi winhaj Gaal yuninal winhaj Ebed yet' heb' yuk'tak t'a tik, wan yak'an sk'ol heb' anima heb' winh t'a a patik.
Yuj chi' kotanh yet' heb' a soldado t'ak'walil, tze k'ub'anel he b'a t'a titak chonhab' tik.
Haxo yik toxo sakb'i, tzex och eyak' owal t'a chonhab' tik, haxo yik tz'elta winhaj Gaal chi' yak' owal het'ok yet' heb' soldado, ol xo ila' tas ol utej winh, xchib'at winhaj Zebul chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Abimelec t'ak'walil yet' heb' soldado. Chanh makan ix aj sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' Siquem chi'.
Ayik wan yelta winhaj Gaal t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi', ix eltapax winhaj Abimelec yet' heb' soldado b'aj k'ub'anel chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Gaal chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Zebul icha tik: --Iltonab'i, masanil t'a sattak witz tz'emul heb' soldado, xchi winh. --Ma'ay, a yenhul lum witz tzal anima'il chi' a ach tik, xchi winhaj Zebul chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Gaal chi': --Hanhejtona' ay heb' wan yemta t'a tzalan skuchan Smuxuk Lum Luum. Wan yempaxul heb' soldado t'a sb'e'al b'aj nab'a ji yik heb' naumel lolonel, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Zebul chi' t'a winh icha tik: --B'ajtil ay a lolonel ix laj al chi' tikne'ik. Ix ala' to malaj yelk'och winhaj Abimelec yik tzonh och schekab'ok winh. Ha tikne'ik chi' sjawi heb' soldado ix a b'uch chi', ixik chinaik, yik tzak' owal yet' heb', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och winhaj Gaal skuchb'an heb' anima t'a Siquem, ix b'at yak'an owal heb' yet' winhaj Abimelec yet' heb' soldado.

Haxo winhaj Abimelec chi' ix och t'a spatik winhaj Gaal yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok. Maj techajlaj skolan sb'a winhaj Gaal chi', ix och lemnaj winh skol sb'a t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Tzijtum mach ix cham t'a stiel chonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Abimelec chi' t'a chonhab' Aruma. Haxo winhaj Zebul chi' ix pechanel winhaj Gaal yet' heb' sk'ab' yok t'a Siquem chi' t'a junelnhej.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at heb' aj Siquem chi' munlajel, ix yab'an winhaj Abimelec chi',

yuj chi' ox makan ix yutej heb' soldado winh, ix sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te'. Ayik ix yilan heb' soldado chi' yelul heb' anima t'a spuerta'il chonhab', ix elta heb' b'aj k'ub'an chi', ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb'.

T'a jun rato chi', ix b'at winhaj Abimelec yet' jun makan heb' soldado smakkan spuerta'il chonhab' chi'. Palta haxo cha makanhxo heb' jun, ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' anima ix elta munlajel t'a spatiktak chonhab' Siquem chi'.

Pilan k'u ix yak' owal winhaj Abimelec chi', masanto ix yak' ganar winh satanel jun chonhab' chi'. Ix smilcham masanil anima winh, ix smak'em weknaj jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix sekankanem atz'am atz'am winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima t'a cuartel b'aj skol sb'a heb' t'a Siquem tas ix ajkan Siquem chi' yuj winhaj Abimelec chi', ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol stemplo komon Dios skuch El-berit.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Abimelec to hata' k'ub'anel heb' anima chi',

ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a jun witz skuchan Salmón. Ix yik'anb'at jun k'e'en ch'akab' winh, ix sch'akanel jun sk'ab' jun te te' winh, ix yak'ank'e te' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' anima to icha pax chi' syutej heb' t'a elanhchamel.

Yuj chi' masanil anima ix ch'akanel junjun sk'ab' te te'. Ix och tzak'an heb' yuj winh masanto ix k'och heb' t'a templo chi'. Ix smolb'ankanoch sk'ab'tak te te' chi' heb' t'a spatik b'aj k'ub'anel heb' anima chi'. Ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al te' heb', yuj chi' ix cham masanil heb' anima ayek' chi' ta'. Ay am milok heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix chami.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Abimelec chi' yet' heb' winh soldado yak' owal t'a chonhab' Tebes. Elanhchamel ix yoy sb'a heb' t'a spatik chonhab' chi', ix yak'an ganar heb'.

Ha t'a snanhal yol jun chonhab' chi', hata' ay jun cuartel b'aj skol sb'a heb' anima ayik ay owal. Hata' ix b'at heb' anima sk'ub'ejel sb'a. Te wach' ix yutej heb' smakan spuerta'il, ix k'e heb' t'a yib'anh.
Ix k'och lemnaj winhaj Abimelec chi' t'a spuerta'il chi' yik syak'anoch sk'ak'al winh yalani.
Haxo jun ix ix ayk'e t'a yib'anh cuartel chi' ix aktanemta jun k'e'en k'e'en yik molino. k'okb'il wal t'a sjolom winhaj Abimelec chi' ix em k'e'en, ix apchaj winh yuj k'e'en.

Elanhchamel ix yal winh t'a jun winh skuchumal syamk'ab' yik owal: Ik'kot k'e'en espada, milinchamok, malaj in gana ol alchajok to a junok ix ix, ix in milani, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'kot k'e'en yespada winh chi', ix stekanoch k'e'en winh t'a winhaj Abimelec chi', ix cham winh.
Ayik ix yilan heb' soldado to toxo ix cham winh, ix meltzaj heb' t'a spat junjun.
Icha chi' ix yutej Dios yak'an spak t'a winhaj Abimelec chi' yuj chukal sk'ulejnak t'a winh smam, ayik smilannakcham 70 heb' winh yuk'tak winh.
Hanheja' icha chi' ix ajpax yak'ji spak t'a heb' anima t'a Siquem chi' yuj schukal, ix elk'och skatab' winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Jerobaal t'a yib'anh heb'.
